name: Deore XT Superplate rear derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 285 g for the RD-M700-SP Superplate assembly. The reference 42T total capacity uses FE-SF21/SF22 fork ends; FE-UF20 instead gives 40T. The catalogue lists 34T largest sprocket with Shimano fork ends and no separate front-difference figure.
